async def act(page):
    # Click the 'Built-in 30' link to view all built-in templates
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Built-in 30").click()
    # Wait for the templates section to update
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Locate the Android template by filtering radio buttons with nearby text containing 'Android'
    # Use get_by_role to find all 'Use template' radio buttons, then filter based on context
    android_radio = page.get_by_role("radio", name="Use template").filter(has_text="Android")
    # If filter doesn't work, try an alternative: use nth based on expected position (e.g., Android might be after iOSSwift)
    if await android_radio.count() == 0:
        # Fallback: assume Android is the next template after iOSSwift (index 4, 0-indexed)
        android_radio = page.get_by_role("radio", name="Use template").nth(4)
    await android_radio.click()
    # Wait for any dynamic fields to appear after template selection
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Fill in the project name
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Project name").fill("web_agent_android_xs")
    # Set the repository as private
    await page.get_by_role("radio", name="Private").click()
    # Click the create button
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Create project").click()
